hebrewText: אַ֤ךְ מִ/שְּׂאֵת֨/וֹ יָעֲצ֣וּ לְ/הַדִּיחַ֮ יִרְצ֪וּ כָ֫זָ֥ב בְּ/פִ֥י/ו יְבָרֵ֑כוּ וּ֝/בְ/קִרְבָּ֗/ם יְקַלְלוּ סֶֽלָה

tokens.bdb: a particle of affirmation, surely; hence (by limitation) only
tokens.kjv: also, in any wise, at least, but, certainly, even, howbeit, nevertheless, notwithstanding, only, save, surely, of a surety, truly, verily, [phrase] wherefore, yet (but).

tokens.bdb: an elevation or leprous scab; figuratively, elation or cheerfulness; exaltation in rank or character
tokens.kjv: be accepted, dignity, excellency, highness, raise up self, rising.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: an elevation or leprous scab; figuratively
tokens.enLiteralWord: an elevation or leprous scab; figuratively
tokens.explanation: an elevation or leprous scab; figuratively
tokens.explanationEn: an elevation or leprous scab; figuratively

tokens.bdb: to advise; reflexively, to deliberate or resolve
tokens.kjv: advertise, take advise, advise (well), consult, (give, take) counsel(-lor), determine, devise, guide, purpose.

tokens.bdb: to push off; used in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (to expel, mislead, strike, inflict, etc.)
tokens.kjv: banish, bring, cast down (out), chase, compel, draw away, drive (away, out, quite), fetch a stroke, force, go away, outcast, thrust away (out), withdraw.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to push off; used in a great variety of applications
tokens.enLiteralWord: to push off; used in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanation: to push off; used in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanationEn: to push off; used in a great variety of applications

tokens.bdb: to be pleased with; specifically, to satisfy adebt
tokens.kjv: (be) accept(-able), accomplish, set affection, approve, consent with, delight (self), enjoy, (be, have a) favour(-able), like, observe, pardon, (be, have, take) please(-ure), reconcile self.
deceitful, false, leasing, + liar, lie, lying.

tokens.bdb: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
tokens.kjv: accord(-ing as, -ing to), after, appointment, assent, collar, command(-ment), [idiom] eat, edge, end, entry, [phrase] file, hole, [idiom] in, mind, mouth, part, portion, [idiom] (should) say(-ing), sentence, skirt, sound, speech, [idiom] spoken, talk, tenor, [idiom] to, [phrase] two-edged, wish, word.

tokens.bdb: to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] abundantly, [idiom] altogether, [idiom] at all, blaspheme, bless, congratulate, curse, [idiom] greatly, [idiom] indeed, kneel (down), praise, salute, [idiom] still, thank.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to kneel; by implication to bless God
tokens.enLiteralWord: to kneel; by implication to bless God
tokens.explanation: to kneel; by implication to bless God
tokens.explanationEn: to kneel; by implication to bless God

tokens.bdb: properly, the nearest part, i.e. the center, whether literal, figurative or adverbial (especially with preposition)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] among, [idiom] before, bowels, [idiom] unto charge, [phrase] eat (up), [idiom] heart, [idiom] him, [idiom] in, inward ([idiom] -ly, part, -s, thought), midst, [phrase] out of, purtenance, [idiom] therein, [idiom] through, [idiom] within self.

tokens.bdb: to be (causatively, make) light, literally (swift, small, sharp, etc.) or figuratively (easy, trifling, vile, etc.)
tokens.kjv: abate, make bright, bring into contempt, (ac-) curse, despise, (be) ease(-y, -ier), (be a, make, make somewhat, move, seem a, set) light(-en, -er, -ly, -ly afflict, -ly esteem, thing), [idiom] slight(-ly), be swift(-er), (be, be more, make, re-) vile, whet.
